La clave secreta de la instancia no abre: The instance's secret key does not open the stored secrets
MIMIRSYNTH_SESSION_SECRET no es la clave: MIMIRSYNTH_SESSION_SECRET is not the key they were sealed with. It happens when a backup is restored on another server, when the database is copied to another installation or when the .env is edited by mistake. Stored secrets that cannot be read: {{total}}.
Vuelve a poner en el .env la clave con l: Put back in the .env the key the instance was installed with, and restart. If it is lost, enter those secrets again and remove two-factor authentication from those accounts in Users («Remove two-factor»); the notice goes once none is left unread.
